---
title: geom-text
subtitle: Text label layer reading strings from the `label` aesthetic.
category: Geoms
since: 0.1.0
engine: markdown
---


One text block is drawn per row at the mapped `(x, y)` with an optional
pixel offset via `dx` and `dy`.

## Usage

```typst
geom-text(
  mapping: none,
  data: none,
  size: 8pt,
  colour: rgb("#222222"),
  anchor: "center",
  dx: 0,
  dy: 0,
  inherit-aes: true,
)
```


## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mapping` | `none` | Layer-specific aesthetic mapping built with [`aes`](../core/aes.qmd). Must map `x`, `y`, and `label`. |
| `data` | `none` | Layer-specific dataset. Falls back to the plot data when `none`. |
| `size` | `8pt` | Text size (a Typst length). |
| `colour` | `rgb("#222222")` | Fixed text colour. Used when no colour mapping is active. |
| `anchor` | `"center"` | CeTZ anchor (e.g. `"center"`, `"west"`) controlling placement. |
| `dx` | `0` | Horizontal offset in canvas units. |
| `dy` | `0` | Vertical offset in canvas units. |
| `inherit-aes` | `true` | Whether to merge the plot-level mapping into this layer's mapping. |

## Returns

Layer dictionary consumed by [`plot`](../core/plot.qmd).

## Examples

```{typst}
//| output-filename: "/assets/typst-render/geom-text-1.svg"
//| width: 10cm
//| height: 6cm
#let d = (
  (x: 1, y: 2, name: "a"),
  (x: 2, y: 4, name: "b"),
  (x: 3, y: 3, name: "c"),
)
#plot(
  data: d,
  mapping: aes(x: "x", y: "y", label: "name"),
  layers: (
    geom-point(size: 2pt),
    geom-text(dy: 0.2),
  ),
)
```

## See also

[`geom-label`](geom-label.qmd), [`aes`](../core/aes.qmd).
